# Tag module (DD-009) Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add the tag chip, the tag patterns and the three Tags screens to the Antz Design System as DD-009 (proposed), ending at a preview deploy.

**Architecture:** CSS in `components.css` (opt-in classes, tokens only). Docs pages and screens are generated by `tools/style7.py` (`write_doc`, `screen_page`, `mod`, `sheet`), rendered by `node tools/docs.mjs`. RN colour roles come from `tools/build.mjs`. The approved PDF (`scratchpad/chip-pdf/make.py`, the `.tag-chip` CSS in it) is the visual reference for the chip.

**Tech Stack:** HTML/CSS, Python 3 generator, Node 22 tools, headless Chrome for the audit and screenshots.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-27-tag-module-design.md`

## Global Constraints
- Tokens only in `components.css`; `node tools/check.mjs` must pass with no new findings (68 covered by EXC-001 stays 68).
- Priority scale: none → `neutral`, Normal `!` → `info`, High `!!` → `caution`, Emergency `!!!` → `danger` (bg/text tokens).
- Public chip: pill (`--radius-full`). Private chip: `--radius-xs` left end, pointed right end (clip-path, 15px deep).
- Every chip with a priority shows its mark (`aria-hidden`) and has visually hidden words ("High priority"); private chips add "Private tag".
- Sentence case; no white-label green buttons (FD-003); ANTZ Rounded icons (`#i-…`); licensed photos only.
- AA in light, dark, light-hc, dark-hc; 24px tap targets; reduced motion respected.
- Frozen releases untouched; do not bump VERSION or cut a release.
- Never use #52F990, #38BD69, #36BC69. Never `--no-verify`. Commits end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Gate before every commit: `node tools/build.mjs --check && node tools/check.mjs && node tools/test.mjs`.

## Review Focus
1. Long tag names (e.g. "Deep clean pending before inspection") in a narrow sheet or phone: chip must not overflow its container; it truncates with an ellipsis and keeps the full name as its accessible name. Test: Tag chips page demo with a long name inside a 320px box, checked in the screenshots step.
2. Private chip with the × remove button: the button must stay clear of the point and keep a 24px target. Test: audit `links` (tap targets) on the Tags page.
3. Chips on a photo hero in dark mode: contrast must not depend on the photo. Test: audit `contrast` on the Animal · tags screen in four modes.
4. Windows high contrast: public and private stay distinguishable. Test: screenshot with `Emulation.setEmulatedMedia forced-colors: active` on the Tag chips page.
5. Phones: tag strip wraps to two lines and still shows at most four chips plus "+N". Test: Animal · tags mobile frame screenshot.

### Task 1: Tag chip CSS and priority picker alignment

**Files:**
- Modify: `components.css` (new section "Tag chip (DD-009)" after the Priority picker section; and `.priority__opt--high`)

**Interfaces:**
- Produces classes: `.tag-chip`, `.tag-chip--private`, `.tag-chip--normal|--high|--emergency`, `.tag-chip__mark`, `.tag-chip__by`, `.tag-chip__remove`, `.tag-chip__lock`, `.tag-chip__label` (truncating text span). Custom props `--tc-bg`, `--tc-fg`. Chips are `<button type="button">` when clickable, `<span>` when static. Visually hidden text uses the existing `.sr-only`.

- [ ] **Step 1:** Add the section, taking values from the PDF CSS: height `var(--size-control-sm)`, padding `0 var(--space-3)`, gap `var(--space-1-5)`, `--text-sm`, `--weight-medium`; private: `padding-right: calc(var(--space-3) + 13px)` and `clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 15px) 0, calc(100% - 3px) 42%, calc(100% - 3px) 58%, calc(100% - 15px) 100%, 0 100%)`; `__by` 22px circle on `--color-surface` / `--color-text-secondary`; `__remove` 24px round button, transparent, current colour; `__label` `min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap`; chip `max-width:100%`. Hover (`button.tag-chip:hover`): `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--tc-fg)`. Focus: the system `:focus-visible` ring. `@media (forced-colors: active)`: `border: 1px solid CanvasText`, `.tag-chip__lock { display:inline-grid }` (hidden otherwise), `.tag-chip--private` drops `clip-path` and uses `border-radius: var(--radius-xs)` so its outline is whole.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Change `.priority__opt--high` to `--color-caution-solid`, `--color-caution-on-solid`, `--color-caution-text`.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Run the gate. Expected: build passes (724 checks), guardrails "0 finding(s), 68 covered", self-tests pass.
- [ ] **Step 4:** Commit `Tag chip: public pill, private tag shape, priority on tokens (DD-009); priority picker High is amber`.
